newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rand Mines says has offer in the wings.
newsitem.headline: Rand Mines says has offer in the wings.

text.p: South Africa's Rand Mines Ltd said on Monday its shareholders were going to receive an offer from a third party.
The firm said news of the offer had emerged at a general shareholders meeting called by Lowenco Nominees Ltd and Performa Trust.

"They (Lowenco and Performa) had been advised that a third party would make an offer to shareholders. If and when this offer is made the directors will consider it and evaluate it," the firm said in a statement.
However, if no formal offer is received by August 22 the firm said it would be wound up and its listings in Johannesburg and London will be ended.
